description.value: Hot Spot Buffet is an all-you-can-eat Korean-Japanese BBQ and hot pot restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, operating under the Japanese name 黑牛の家. It stands out for its unusually late closing time of 1 AM and free on-site parking, making it a viable option for cycling groups finishing a long day on the road. The restaurant accommodates groups up to 10 and serves beer alongside its buffet, which includes BBQ meats, skewers, hot pot, and optional seafood upgrades.
